Subject: IAM evidence & next steps (SOC 2, SSO/SCIM)

Hi Susan / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the identity & access items you flagged:

1) SOC 2 status: we are SOC 2 Type II compliant (report available on request).
2) SSO / SAML: we support SAML 2.0 SSO and can provide metadata and step-by-step configuration for Okta/AzureAD.
3) SCIM provisioning: full SCIM v2 provisioning is available for provisioning/deprovisioning.
4) RBAC & admin controls: we have role-based permission docs and a recommended admin separation guide.

Can you confirm the artifacts you need from us and the timeline? From our side, we can assemble: SOC 2 attestation, SAML metadata file, SCIM provisioning guide, RBAC matrix, and any short screencast if helpful.

Proposed timeline: get the artifacts to you by EOW (Friday) if that works, otherwise let me know required date.

Next steps:
- Confirm list of required documents (reply-all)
- If procurement needs a PO or specific contact, loop them in

Thanks, I'll pull the security team into a follow-up thread to gather the artifacts.

Best,

Thanks Marissa, that summary is helpful. A few clarifications / asks from our security and procurement teams: 

- Please provide the SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 snapshot/summary) and date of the latest audit.

- SCIM provisioning guide (including supported attribute mappings and deprovision timing).

Timeline: procurement needs to validate controls by next Wednesday (2027-03-03). Is that feasible? If not, please advise earliest possible delivery.

Also looping procurement in case they need a separate contract/PO path.

- scim_provisioning_guide.pdf (SCIM v2 provisioning guide, attribute mappings, sample requests)

Notes / answers to Aurora's specific asks:
- Latest SOC 2 audit date: 2026-11-15 (Type II). Summary included in the SOC PDF. Full report provided under NDA if requested.
- SAML: we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO, ACS URL is https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs, certificate thumbprint included in metadata.
- SCIM: provisioning supports create/update/deactivate; deprovisioning occurs within 15 minutes of user disable event.
- RBAC: default roles include Viewer, Editor, Admin, Billing. Custom roles supported via API.
- Audit logs: admin activity and token issuance are retained for 365 days in our audit log system. Exports available on request.

If you want me to attach a redacted full report behind DocuSign/NDA, tell me and I'll route it.

Attaching files now.
